name: compute_src2dst
description: Routing inverse-permutation construction with signature compute_src2dst(reorder_ids, num_toks). reorder_ids is a flat length-num_toks permutation of 0..num_toks-1, accepted as int32 or int64; int64 values are read through their low 32-bit word. For each source position d, set out[reorder_ids[d]] = d. Return a newly allocated int32 tensor of length num_toks. Both inputs are read-only; reorder_ids values must be in range and form a permutation. The suite exercises sizes from 1 to 1,048,576.
